summary: Haldir Gate: an experimental Rust reference monitor that authorizes one mission-level plant command at a time and keeps evidence for each observed stage; release 0.9.0 is NO_GO. AGENTS.md is the operating contract; this index restates its operational facts for tools.

delivery.merge: Create one signed one-parent commit with the pinned identity and equal author and committer times, push the branch, open a pull request, dispatch ci.yml and formal.yml on it, require all seven contexts on that head, fast-forward main with git push origin <commit>:refs/heads/main, then close the pull request without merging.
delivery.signing: SSH-signed with the pinned identity; never amend, squash, cherry-pick or rebase a checked commit
delivery.attribution: no AI attribution or co-author trailers
